integrity: The proof uses the source's explicit flight and Poincaré formulas, verifies positive flight times at the boundary orbit, and derives the recurrence algebraically. The iteration asymptotic is analytic and does not depend on numerical fitting. General grazing square-root literature remains a stated originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the affine two-field large-hysteresis model, the singular boundary relation, and the returning side of the section. The constant in the second-order escape asymptotic is not given in closed form, and persistence under nonlinear, noisy, or smoothed perturbations is not claimed.
title: One-sided grazing instability and logarithmically corrected escape in a large-hysteresis return map
